exposure: regular diet recovery after restoration of normal muscle strength of both lower extremities
control group (traditional postoperative fasting guidelines, waiting 6 hours before eating)
observation group (resumed eating after regaining lower extremity muscle strength)
cohort: 240 patients who underwent elective cesarean section at Xiangya Hospital, Central South University
finding: Food intake after restoration of lower extremity muscle strength improved time to first flatus, reduced postoperative pain, shortened hospital stay, and enhanced satisfaction after elective cesarean section, without adverse effects.
